notes.title: Spooky Scary Flying Machine
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=rJ7LWUFV9n8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

At the first floor of the game, there is now a pentagon shaped portal to the Halloween levels.
You will be blowing up pumpkins and pushing skeletons.

There is also a new type of propeller for you to play with, the Ghost Propeller.
It was actually an idea of a viewer in my stream on twitch.

There is a nice reward if you manage to beat the whole event.

Good luck and happy halloween.

notes.title: Lowered The Price
notes.content:
I actually meant to lower the price for a while now. The thing was, Steam does not allow games to change their price sooner than a month after release. 
So, there you have it, 11.99$ for Really Bad Flying Machine.
There might be sales in the future. But, the base price will probably not change anymore.
